evals.name: route-needs-the-fake-extended
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`, Playwright's Chromium is installed, and `bun run test` in `web/` and `go test ./...` at the root are green. The router has a `site` route (`/sites/:id`, `SitePage.vue`); the app server answers `GET /api/sites/{id}` by asking the inventory for `/sites/{id}`, which the fake inventory (`internal/fake`, run by `cmd/fake-upstream`) does not serve. No spec visits a site page.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies, Playwright's Chromium, and a Go toolchain with the fixture's modules cached, to build, run the fake and the app server, and run the specs.

evals.name: route-with-no-spec
evals.setup: The same fixture repository as scenario 1, clean tree, everything installed and green. No spec visits the settings page (`/settings`, its date zone `SelectButton`).
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies, Playwright's Chromium, and a Go toolchain, to build and run the specs.

evals.name: all-routes-plan
evals.setup: The same fixture repository as scenario 1, clean tree, everything installed and green. The user answers the plan with `none, just the plan`.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies, Playwright's Chromium, and a Go toolchain, for the baseline run.
